old_caption: The video captures a serene riverside scene, showcasing a modern architectural structure with a curved roof and large glass windows, situated on a grassy embankment. The building is surrounded by lush greenery, including trees and shrubs, which add to the tranquil atmosphere. A green sign near the water contains legible text: 'No Thanks, We just ate. Please don't feed the birds.' The camera remains static throughout the sequence. The river is calm, reflecting the building and trees. In the distance, additional brick buildings can be seen. The overall ambiance is peaceful, with the vibrant greenery creating a picturesque setting.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a serene riverside scene, showcasing a modern architectural structure with a curved roof and large glass windows, situated on a grassy embankment. The building is surrounded by lush greenery, including trees and shrubs, which add to the tranquil atmosphere. A sign near the water reads "No Thanks, We just ate," indicating a nearby food source for wildlife. As the camera pans left, it reveals more of the riverbank, lined with rocks and bordered by a paved walkway. The river itself is calm, reflecting the clear blue sky above. In the distance, additional buildings can be seen, blending industrial and residential styles. The overall ambiance is peaceful, with the gentle flow of the river and the vibrant greenery creating a picturesque setting.
caption: The video captures a waterfront amphitheater on a clear day, where the camera pans slowly and continuously to the left. A white arched canopy pavilion on angled pillars sits in the mid-ground, backed by a red-brick tower and a curved glass facade. A tilted green sign reading "No Thanks, We just ate. Please don't feed the birds" stands in the foreground pond. As the view shifts, every fixed element drifts rightward, the pavilion and tower sliding toward the right edge and the sign toward center. The pan reveals more of the left bank, bringing additional trees, a rocky shoreline curving into the water, and a lamppost at the far-left edge. The few people near the pavilion hold their positions relative to the structure, confirming the motion is camera-driven. Water-surface reflections shimmer subtly while the foliage and buildings otherwise remain still.

an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
